# Job Chapter 34 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 429r–429v

---

**34:1** And-answered [vaya'an] Elihu and-said: **34:2** "Hear [shim'u], O-wise-ones [chakhamim], my-words [millai], and-knowing-ones [yode'im] give-ear [ha'azinu] to-me. **34:3** For the-ear [ozen] tests [tivkhan] words [millin], as-the-palate [chekh] tastes [yit'am] to-eat [le-ekhol].

**34:4** Justice [mishpat] let-us-choose [nivcharah] for-ourselves; let-us-know [nede'ah] among-ourselves what [is] good [tov]. **34:5** For Iyyov has-said, 'I-am-righteous [tsadaqti], and-God [El] has-turned-aside [hesir] my-justice [mishpati]. **34:6** Against my-justice [mishpati] shall-I-lie [akazzev]? My-wound [chitssi] [is] incurable [anush] without transgression [beli-pasha].'

**34:7** What man [gever] [is] like-Iyyov? He-drinks [yishteh] scoffing [la'ag] like-water [ka-mayim]. **34:8** And-he-travels [orach] in-company [le-chevrah] with-doers of-iniquity [po'alei aven] and-to-walk [lalekhet] with-men of-wickedness [anshei resha]. **34:9** For he-has-said, 'It-does-not profit [lo yiskon] a-man [gever] in-his-delighting [be-ritsoto] with God [im-Elohim].'

**34:10** Therefore, men of-heart [anshei levav], hear [shim'u] to-me: Far-be-it [chalilah] from-God [la-El] from-wickedness [me-resha], and-from-the-Almighty [mi-Shaddai] from-injustice [me-avel]. **34:11** For the-work of-a-man [po'al adam] he-repays [yeshallem] to-him, and-according-to the-way of-a-man [orach ish] he-causes-to-find-him [yamtsi'ehu].

**34:12** Surely [af-omnam], God [El] does-not act-wickedly [lo yarshi'a], and-the-Almighty [Shaddai] does-not pervert [lo ye'avvet] justice [mishpat]. **34:13** Who entrusted [paqad] to-him the-earth [artsah]? And-who set [sam] the-whole world [tevel kullahh]? **34:14** If he-set [yasim] upon-him his-heart [libbo], his-spirit [rucho] and-his-breath [nishmato] to-himself he-gathers [ye'esof]: **34:15** All flesh [kol-basar] would-expire [yigva] together [yachad], and-man [adam] to-dust [al-afar] would-return [yashuv].

**34:16** And-if [you have] understanding [binah], hear [shim'ah] this; give-ear [ha'azinah] to-the-sound of-my-words [qol millai]. **34:17** Shall-indeed one-who-hates [ha-af sonei] justice [mishpat] govern [yachavosh]? And-the-Righteous-Mighty-One [tsaddiq kabbir], will-you-condemn [tarshi'a]?

**34:18** [Is it fitting] to-say to-a-king [le-melekh], "Worthless-one [beliyya'al]"? "Wicked-one [rasha]" to-nobles [nadivim]? **34:19** Who does-not show-favor [lo nasa panim] to-princes [sarim] and-does-not recognize [lo nikkar] the-rich [shoah] before [lifnei] the-poor [dal]; for the-work of-his-hands [ma'aseh yadav] [are] all of-them.

**34:20** In-a-moment [rega] they-die [yamutu], and-in-the-middle of-the-night [chatsot lailah] the-people [am] are-shaken [ye'go'ashu] and-pass-away [veya'avoru]; and-the-mighty [abbir] are-removed [vayasiru] not by-hand [lo ve-yad]. **34:21** For his-eyes [einav] [are] upon the-ways [darkhei] of-a-man [ish], and-all his-steps [tse'adav] he-sees [yir'eh]. **34:22** There-is-no darkness [choshekh] and-no shadow-of-death [tsalmut] where the-doers of-iniquity [po'alei aven] can-hide [le-hissater] themselves.

**34:23** For he-does-not set [lo yasim] upon a-man [ish] yet [od] to-go [la-halokh] to God [El] in-judgment [ba-mishpat]. **34:24** He-shatters [yaro'a] the-mighty [kabbirim] without searching-out [lo cheqer] and-sets [vaya'amed] others [acherim] in-their-place [tachtam]. **34:25** Therefore he-knows [yakkir] their-works [ma'avadeihem], and-he-overturns [ve-hafakh] [in the] night [lailah] and-they-are-crushed [veyiddakke'u]. **34:26** In-the-place of-the-wicked [resha'im] he-strikes-them [sefaqam], in-the-place of-those-who-see [bi-mqom ro'im]. **34:27** Because they-turned-aside [saru] from-following-him [me-acharav] and-did-not consider [lo hiskilu] all his-ways [darakhav], **34:28** to-bring [le-havi] upon-him the-cry of-the-poor [tsa'aqat-dal], and-the-cry of-the-afflicted [tsa'aqat aniyyim] he-hears [yishma].

**34:29** And-when-he-is-quiet [yasqit], who will-condemn [yarshi'a]? And-when-he-hides [yaster] [his] face [panim], who will-behold-him [yeshurehu]? Whether over-a-nation [al-goy] or-over-a-man [al-adam] alike [yachad], **34:30** from-reigning [mi-melokh] a-godless-man [adam chanef], from-snares [mi-moqshei] of-the-people [am].

**34:31** For to God [El] has-anyone-said [he-amar], 'I-have-borne [nasati], I-will-not-act-corruptly [lo echbol]? **34:32** Apart-from [bil'adei] what-I-see [echezeh], you teach-me [horeni]; if I-have-done [pa'alti] injustice [avel], I-will-not-do-it-again [lo osif].'

**34:33** [Should it be] from-with-you [me-immekha] he-repays-it [yeshallemennah], for you-reject [ma'asta]? For you must-choose [tivchar] and-not I; and-what you-know [yada'ta] speak [dabber].

**34:34** Men of-heart [anshei levav] will-say to-me, and-a-wise-man [gever chakham] who-hears [shomea] to-me: **34:35** 'Iyyov speaks without knowledge [da'at], and-his-words [devarav] [are] without insight [haskel].' **34:36** Would [avi] that-Iyyov were-tested [yibachen] to-the-end [ad-netsach], on-account-of answers [teshuvot] among-men of-iniquity [anshei-aven]. **34:37** For he-adds [yosif] upon his-sin [chatta'to] rebellion [pesha]; among-us he-claps [yisphoq], and-he-multiplies [yarbeh] his-words [amarav] against-God [la-El]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "My wound is incurable":** Hebrew *chitssi anush* — literally "my arrow is incurable." *Chets* can mean "arrow" or "wound." Elihu quotes Job as saying his suffering-wound is mortal despite his innocence.

**v.14-15 — "If he set his heart... all flesh would expire":** Elihu argues that all life depends on God's sustaining will. If God withdrew his spirit (*ruach*) and breath (*neshamah*), creation would collapse instantly. This echoes Psalm 104:29.

**v.20 — "not by hand":** Hebrew *lo ve-yad* — God removes the mighty without human agency. This phrase emphasizes divine sovereignty that operates beyond human mechanisms, echoing Daniel 2:34.

*— EMET*
